note: CodeWarrior Pro 4 Tools CD, Installer VISE: Custom Install > Full MacOS Install. StdCLibInit (PPC before 7.6) is copied from the CD, so one snapshot serves 7.5.5 too. The option list is drawn by VISE (a pixel click); the rest is by name.
